assurance_review_unattributed_rationale.name: assurance_review_unattributed_rationale
assurance_review_unattributed_rationale.value: "assurance_review"."unattributed_realised_value" is null or "assurance_review"."unattributed_realised_rationale" is not null

assurance_review_finalised_shape.name: assurance_review_finalised_shape
assurance_review_finalised_shape.value: ("assurance_review"."status" = 'finalised') = ("assurance_review"."finalised_by" is not null and "assurance_review"."finalised_at" is not null)

leakage_assessment_snapshot_shape.name: leakage_assessment_snapshot_shape
leakage_assessment_snapshot_shape.value: "leakage_assessment"."snapshot_taken_at" is null or ("leakage_assessment"."snapshot_status" is not null and "leakage_assessment"."snapshot_title" is not null and "leakage_assessment"."snapshot_driver_ids" is not null)

leakage_assessment_unrecoverable_validat.name: leakage_assessment_unrecoverable_validated
leakage_assessment_unrecoverable_validat.value: "leakage_assessment"."unrecoverable_amount" = 0 or ("leakage_assessment"."unrecoverable_rationale" is not null and "leakage_assessment"."unrecoverable_validated_by" is not null)

project_value_period_order.name: project_value_period_order
project_value_period_order.value: "project"."value_period_start" is null or "project"."value_period_end" is null or "project"."value_period_start" <= "project"."value_period_end"

report_issue_subject_shape.name: report_issue_subject_shape
report_issue_subject_shape.value:
("report_issue"."type" = 'information_request') = ("report_issue"."information_request_id" is not null)
        and ("report_issue"."type" = 'requalification') = ("report_issue"."value_case_version_id" is not null)
        and ("report_issue"."type" = 'assurance') = ("report_issue"."assurance_review_id" is not null)
        and ("report_issue"."type" = 'value_change_notice') = ("report_issue"."value_change_id" is not null)

value_case_version_kind_shape.name: value_case_version_kind_shape
value_case_version_kind_shape.value:
("value_case_version"."kind" = 'inherited_business_case' and "value_case_version"."version_number" = 0 and "value_case_version"."status" in ('draft', 'recorded'))
       or ("value_case_version"."kind" = 'value_case' and "value_case_version"."version_number" >= 1 and "value_case_version"."status" <> 'recorded' and "value_case_version"."stated_total_value" is null)

value_case_version_proposed_shape.name: value_case_version_proposed_shape
value_case_version_proposed_shape.value: "value_case_version"."status" not in ('proposed', 'authorised', 'superseded') or ("value_case_version"."proposed_at" is not null and "value_case_version"."proposed_by" is not null)

value_case_version_authorised_shape.name: value_case_version_authorised_shape
value_case_version_authorised_shape.value:
"value_case_version"."status" not in ('authorised', 'superseded') or (
            "value_case_version"."authorised_on" is not null and "value_case_version"."authorised_by_person_id" is not null
        and "value_case_version"."authorisation_evidence_id" is not null and "value_case_version"."authorisation_recorded_by" is not null
        and "value_case_version"."authorisation_recorded_at" is not null)

value_change_proposed_shape.name: value_change_proposed_shape
value_change_proposed_shape.value: "value_change"."status" in ('draft', 'withdrawn') or ("value_change"."proposed_at" is not null and "value_change"."proposed_by" is not null and "value_change"."reason" is not null)

value_change_authorised_shape.name: value_change_authorised_shape
value_change_authorised_shape.value:
"value_change"."status" <> 'authorised' or (
            "value_change"."authorised_on" is not null and "value_change"."authorised_by_person_id" is not null
        and "value_change"."authorisation_evidence_id" is not null and "value_change"."authorisation_recorded_by" is not null
        and "value_change"."authorisation_recorded_at" is not null)

value_change_closed_shape.name: value_change_closed_shape
value_change_closed_shape.value: ("value_change"."status" in ('rejected', 'withdrawn')) = ("value_change"."closed_at" is not null and "value_change"."closed_by" is not null)

value_driver_version_benefit_dates_order.name: value_driver_version_benefit_dates_order
value_driver_version_benefit_dates_order.value: "value_driver_version"."benefit_start_date" is null or "value_driver_version"."benefit_full_date" is null or "value_driver_version"."benefit_start_date" <= "value_driver_version"."benefit_full_date"

value_leakage_origin.name: value_leakage_origin
value_leakage_origin.value: "value_leakage"."identified_in_review_id" is not null or "value_leakage"."identified_on" is not null

value_leakage_working_rationale.name: value_leakage_working_rationale
value_leakage_working_rationale.value: "value_leakage"."working_unrecoverable_amount" is null or "value_leakage"."working_unrecoverable_amount" = 0 or "value_leakage"."working_unrecoverable_rationale" is not null

value_leakage_working_attribution.name: value_leakage_working_attribution
value_leakage_working_attribution.value: "value_leakage"."working_total_amount" is null or ("value_leakage"."working_assessed_by" is not null and "value_leakage"."working_assessed_at" is not null)

value_position_not_assessed_shape.name: value_position_not_assessed_shape
value_position_not_assessed_shape.value: not "value_position"."forecast_not_assessed" or ("value_position"."current_forecast" is null and "value_position"."forecast_rationale" is not null)
